about: The record's allow-list (CD6). SessionRecord.kt and scrub.ts each keep their sets as code and test them against this file. Add a key here and on both sides, with its reason. scalars names each key the core writes that only ever holds a number, a boolean or null: those pass under any key, so they sit on no list, and naming them here makes that a decision. kinds names each record kind the core writes, with what it records: a kind passes only as a plain word.

reasons.answer: native: the class name of a code or start answer (Open, Waiting, Status…), never its body
reasons.appVersion: native: the build's version and number, 1.0.0-656: app.json's version and the commit count app.config.ts builds it with (owner, 2026-10-26)
reasons.attempt: both: an attempt id is a number; a word here is a label
reasons.cause: native: ReconnectCause wire, the broadcast's Cause wire, StallCause wire (video-stalled) or NotDeliveredCause wire (not-delivered)
reasons.claim: both: Claim wire, new or resume (A9): native on pair and on the beat line, JS on intent.pair
reasons.count: both: a count; native: srt-send-dropped, the packets dropped since its last line; bitrate-held, the due raises F-P5-7's gate held since its last line (R-990P); bitrate, on a raise only, those held since the last bitrate-held line, which no held line will say (review of #23)
reasons.endReason: both: EndReason wire, or the server's reason word
reasons.error: plan C: a throwable's class name only, never its message (CD30); or pair-step-late's camera-busy word
reasons.failure: native: ConnectFailure wire (connect-failed: unresolved, refused, timeout, other, unheld, camera), or StartFailure wire (start-failed)
reasons.field: native: the name of a field the server sent that could not be read, never its value (waiting-unreadable, final review I-2b)
reasons.from: native: a transport (fell-back), a bitrate in bits per second (bitrate), a state or phase name, or where a camera loss was heard (camera-lost: device, start)
reasons.host: both: a bare host, never a path or query (plan A I1)
reasons.key: JS: a dictionary or store key name, never a value; native: a private store's file name (phone-id, stopped-records, forgotten-pairing)
reasons.kind: JS: a failure kind word (code.error, surface.unavailable), written to the line as field_kind; native: a Wire
reasons.op: both: a store operation name (native: read, write, prune, delete)
reasons.pickSource: native: preview-size, which rule chose the preview's size: ours (16:9 first) or vendor (StreamPack's area rule); a preview-failed line with action sizes for the same camera overrides ours (see preview-failed)
reasons.problem: both: a parse problem word; JS: the scanned code's, native: the code answer's (code-unreadable)
reasons.reason: both: a reason word (EndReason, DropReason and UnpairReason wires included); native bitrate: the regulator's rule that moved the target, drops, backlog, raise or clamp (R-990P); native preview-relaid: why the preview was laid out again, requested or empty (N42)
reasons.result: native: HeartbeatResult wire (heartbeat), or answered or timeout (final-beat, A8)
reasons.rootError: native: the class of the first throw in a failed start's cause chain, when one of another class wraps it (capture-start-failed, F-S4-1); never a message
reasons.side: native: Side wire, left or right (A11)
reasons.sid: native: a broadcast id; no secret (amendment, A17)
reasons.site: native: where a failed start's first throw was made, as Type.method, names only (capture-start-failed, F-S4-1)
reasons.slot: both: a camera position on the match
reasons.source: native: which server answer a line is about, a closed word (waiting-unreadable: beat or descriptor)
reasons.status: both: an HTTP status (JS code.error; native code, final-beat, stopped-delivered), a thermal status (native thermal), or a check word
reasons.tag: plan C: a vendor log's tag, a class name (CD30)
reasons.to: native: a transport (fell-back), a bitrate in bits per second (bitrate), or a state or phase name
reasons.tokenTag: both: which issue of a code, eight hex digits; never the token (carry 2)
reasons.word: native: the class name of a ServerWord verdict

scalars.audioFps: native: video-stalled, audio packets per second, or null
scalars.bandwidthBps: native: bitrate, SRT's bandwidth estimate at the reading the target moved on, or null (RTMPS has none) (R-990P)
scalars.bytes: JS: record.send, the size of the body Send record to Seazn sent or would have sent (R3)
scalars.camera: native: readiness, whether the camera has frames
scalars.counted: native: connect-failed and dropped, whether the failure counted toward a fallback
scalars.dropped: native: bitrate, the sender's dropped packets since the reading before (R-990P)
scalars.egressBps: native: bitrate, the egress the move was decided on, or null: a cut's reading, and a raise's interval mean that passed F-P5-7's gate (review of #23); bitrate-held, the mean egress of the interval the gate held, or null when none of its readings measured any (R-990P)
scalars.encodeListed: native: preview-size, whether the camera lists the encode's own size (1280 x 720) among the sizes StreamPack's PreviewView chooses from
scalars.exitAtMs: native: previous-session-lost, when the process exited (epoch ms), or null
scalars.failed: native: beats, the minute's beats that failed or never came back
scalars.failures: native: rejoin-retry, how many of the rejoin's connects have failed
scalars.gapMs: native: tick-late and frames-gap, the gap's length
scalars.gateBps: native: bitrate-held, F-P5-7's raise gate at the target: 70% of its expected egress, rounded up, so the least egress that raises (R-990P; review of #23)
scalars.headroom: native: thermal, the platform's thermal headroom, or null
scalars.held: native: readiness, whether the phone is held level; beat-interval, whether a broadcast is held
scalars.intervalMs: native: beat-interval, the cadence the phone beats at
scalars.lagGrowthMs: native: not-delivered, how far the playlist fell behind, or null
scalars.lagMs: native: capture-clock, how far the first video frame's capture time trails the wall clock
scalars.late: native: start-answered, true when the answer came after its hold was retired (C0b I1)
scalars.listed: native: preview-size, how many sizes the camera lists for a SurfaceHolder, the class StreamPack's PreviewView asks for
scalars.lost: native: bitrate, SRT's lost packets since the reading before; RTMPS reports none, so 0 (R-990P)
scalars.minuteEpochMs: native: beats, the minute's start on the wall clock
scalars.msSinceAdvance: native: video-stalled, the time since the last frame
scalars.ok: native: camera-reopened, whether the camera came back
scalars.pickAspect16x9: native: preview-size, whether the preview's size has the encode's 16:9 aspect (N30)
scalars.pickHeight: native: preview-size, the height of the size the preview gets (pickSource says which rule chose it), or 0 when no size is listed
scalars.pickWidth: native: preview-size, the width of the size the preview gets (pickSource says which rule chose it), or 0 when no size is listed
scalars.publishedMs: native: dropped, how long the attempt published
scalars.rebaselined: native: video-stalled, whether the watchdog had re-based its clock
scalars.rebuilds: native: camera-gave-up, the loss rebuilds made since an open was last seen
scalars.refusedSid: native: start-answered, true when the answer named a sid this pairing refused (re-review 3 I)
scalars.retryMs: native: rejoin-retry, the wait before the next connect
scalars.sameArea: native: preview-size, how many sizes other than the encode's own share its area (a tie StreamPack breaks by list order)
scalars.sendBufferMs: native: bitrate, SRT's send buffer as reported at the reading, a negative reading included, or null (RTMPS has none) (R-990P)
scalars.sent: native: beats, the beats sent in the minute
scalars.sinceLastMs: native: beat-interval, the gap since the beat before, or null for the first
scalars.sound: native: readiness, whether the microphone heard enough
scalars.srtOffered: native: armed, whether the code offered SRT
scalars.stalledMs: native: not-delivered, how long the playlist stood still
scalars.stopped: native: pair, whether a stopped record was carried in (A17)
scalars.suppressed: native: engine-error and readiness, the lines held back since the last one written (review 14, G3; review C4a, I-1)
scalars.target: native: bitrate-held, the video target the gate held, in bits per second (R-990P)
scalars.validated: native: network, connect-failed and dropped, whether the network was validated
scalars.videoFps: native: video-stalled and bitrate-held (R-990P), encoded frames per second, or null
scalars.wasLive: native: ended, unpaired and broadcast-ended, whether the broadcast had gone live

kinds.armed: native: the code answered open and the session is armed
kinds.automatic: native: the operator switched automatic start
kinds.beat-interval: native: the beat cadence changed (plan D §3.4), with the gap since the beat before
kinds.beats: native: one minute's beats: how many went, how many failed, and the last answer word (plan D §3.4)
kinds.bitrate: native: the regulator moved the encode bitrate, with the rule that moved it and the link reading it moved on (R-990P)
kinds.bitrate-held: native: F-P5-7's raise gate held due raises while on air, at most one line a minute: the target, the held interval's mean egress, the gate, how many were held since the last line, and the encoded frame rate (R-990P)
kinds.broadcast-ended: native: the server ended the held broadcast
kinds.broadcast-start: native: a broadcast began arming, with its sid and cause
kinds.camera-busy: native: the capture could not open because another app holds the camera (I4)
kinds.camera-gave-up: native: the capture stopped rebuilding a camera lost at every open, after its rebuilds with no open seen; it stays not ready until the next foreground or re-pair (re-review 4)
kinds.camera-lost: native: StreamPack lost our camera (from device: Camera2 disconnected it, or a device error) or it failed a start (from start), with the attempt held; it reads not ready and is built afresh with nothing on air (F-S4-1)
kinds.camera-released: native: the camera was given back to the app
kinds.camera-reopened: native: the camera reopened, or failed to
kinds.camera-resumed: native: frames came back after the camera returned
kinds.camera-taken: native: another app took the camera
kinds.capture-call-failed: native: a StreamPack teardown or reopen call threw, with the call and the throwable's class name; the next call still ran (Task 36). Also a photo that failed (action photo): refused as not-ready because the camera is not ours or has failed or been lost, timeout at the bound, or the throwable's class name (spec §8)
kinds.capture-clock: native: the first video frame of an attempt reached the endpoint, with its capture lag behind the wall clock (carry 5)
kinds.capture-rebuilt: native: the capture was released and built again, with why: an Orient for the other side (CD42), a camera lost (F-S4-1), or a camera released with nothing on air (reopen)
kinds.capture-start-failed: native: a connect's start threw, with its attempt, the throwable's class, where its first throw was made (Type.method) and that throw's class when another wraps it; names only, never a message (F-S4-1)
kinds.capture-unheld: native: a connect reached the capture with no camera held, so nothing could open it (C6 m-3), with its attempt; it is answered at once as a failed connect
kinds.code: native: an answer to a code fetch that decided nothing yet
kinds.code-ended-pending: native: the code ended while a broadcast was held
kinds.code-unreadable: native: the code's answer could not be read
kinds.command-failed: native: a command threw on the platform
kinds.connect-failed-ignored: native: a connect failure for no attempt in hand, recorded and ignored (review 14, G4)
kinds.cred-host-refused: native: the credentials named a foreign ingest host
kinds.delivered: native: the playlist showed delivery again
kinds.ended: native: the pairing ended, operator-stopped or fatal-error
kinds.engine-error: native: the engine caught its own failure
kinds.engine.malformed-snapshot: JS, through native's record: snapshots the bridge could not read and kept out, with how many so far, at most a line a minute (review C4c I-4)
kinds.fgs-refused: native: the pairing's foreground service could not go foreground (C3), with the throwable's class name; the pairing carries on and says to keep the app open (Task 38)
kinds.final-beat: native: A8's one final beat, answered or timed out
kinds.frames-gap: native: a Frames read saw video unmoved while publishing, written once with the gap when it moved again, at most 6 a minute with the lines held back (CD33, Open 11, F-S7-3)
kinds.heartbeat: native: a beat's answer, written when it changes
kinds.hold-expired: native: an outage outlasted its hold window
kinds.intent-ignored: native: an intent that did not fit the phase
kinds.intent-unreadable: native: an intent that mapped to nothing, by its kind (review 11)
kinds.keeper-failed: native: the keeper's marker, wake lock, notification, service stop or permission request failed, with which (each release step alone: stop-service, wake-lock, marker, review C7 M-1) and the throwable's class name; it costs a line, never the pairing (Task 38, N1)
kinds.no-accelerometer: native: the phone has no accelerometer, so held never blocks and the side is left (A11)
kinds.not-current: native: the code answered that the broadcast is not current
kinds.not-delivered: native: the playlist stopped showing delivery
kinds.open-ignored: native: the server named a sid this pairing refused
kinds.pair: native: a pair was asked for, with its claim, slot and token tag
kinds.pair-refused: native: a pair whose values fell outside the contract
kinds.pair-step-late: native: a pairing step's failure for a pairing no longer held, recorded only (P11, CD21)
kinds.permissions-late: native: a permissions answer after the pairing moved on
kinds.platform-failed: native: a platform failure, stale or after the end
kinds.power: the app's battery mode under mode (unrestricted, optimized or restricted; null when unread): native at every pairing's hold, and JS when a return to the foreground reads a change (N27; M4 and M5 of the Batch 5 review)
kinds.preview-failed: native: the viewfinder's native preview could not report itself, follow the streamer, open the camera, read the camera's sizes or check its own layout for the 16:9 rule, with which (attach, visibility, detach, follow, open, sizes, relayout, seam) and the throwable's class name; it never crashes the app, and a relayout line stops the layout checks. A sizes line is written once per camera, and means that camera's preview got StreamPack's own size, whatever its preview-size line says: that line comes from a read of its own (Task 39, I5, review C7 I-1 and I-2, N30)
kinds.preview-relaid: native: the preview was laid out again, at the encode’s size, because a view under it waited for a layout or a shown view had no size at two checks a second apart (reason requested or empty); one line an episode, its first relayout, and a healthy check ends it. A SurfaceView left unlaid gets no surface, so the box stays black while the broadcast runs (N42)
kinds.preview-size: native: each time the camera changes, when StreamPack reports its source open, the sizes the camera lists for the preview and the size the preview gets: which rule chose it and whether it is 16:9, as numbers, booleans and one plain word (preview-fill review I-1, N30); evidence, nothing acts on it
kinds.previous-session-lost: native: the previous run held a session and its process died, with the exit reason (F-P5-3, CD22)
kinds.readiness: native: a readiness check changed, with each check, the side and the lines held back (A11, review C4a I-1)
kinds.ready: native: every readiness check passed, with the side held
kinds.record.send: JS, through native's record while a pairing is held: Send record to Seazn's result word, HTTP status and body size (R3 of the D3 findings design); never the server's reference or the token
kinds.rejoin-retry: native: a rejoin of a broadcast whose hold ran out failed a connect and waits (N29): the wait and how many have failed
kinds.rendition-refused: native: the master placed its rendition off the playback host, once a session, with a fixed reason word (re-review 6)
kinds.reset: native: the ended session was reset to idle
kinds.resumed: native: the broadcast resumed after an outage
kinds.scoring-link: native: a tap asked for the Remote scoring link; its word and status only, never the url; or, when the call failed locally (RP4), result failed and the throwable's class name; or result stale when the pairing changed before the answer came (the old match's link is not handed over)
kinds.scripted: native, debug builds only: the scripted code server answered a request (Task 34), naming its route and status, never its body
kinds.srt-send-dropped: native: our SRT sink's send buffer was full, so packets were dropped (StreamPack#302, C7u); with the attempt and the count since the last line, at most one line in 10 s
kinds.stale-connected: native: a connect for an attempt no longer in hand
kinds.start-answered: native: the answer to a POST start, late or not
kinds.start-asked: native: the operator's hold posted a start
kinds.start-refused: native: the server refused a start
kinds.stopped-delivered: native: A17's stopped record was heard, or its code ended
kinds.store-failed: native: the private store refused a read or a write, with the operation and file
kinds.store-unreadable: native: a private store file held a value no rule reads (G2)
kinds.tick-late: native: two snapshot ticks more than 1000 ms apart while Paired or a broadcast was held, with the gap (CD33, carry 14)
kinds.tls-closer-swallowed: native: the TLS guard swallowed Ktor's closer throw on an RTMP IO thread (F-P5-12), with its class name
kinds.unpaired: native: the pairing ended without a broadcast end
kinds.vendor-log: native: StreamPack, or komuxer under its RTMPS (C6 m-4), logged a warning or an error (CD30): its tag, its message as text, and the throwable's class name
kinds.video-stalled: native: the watchdog saw no frames and rebuilt the encoder
kinds.waiting-unreadable: native: a 2xx beat or session shape owed the waiting fields and one could not be read, so the pairing kept its own (label, poll seconds and the rest); names the field, never its value; once a pairing (final review I-2b)
kinds.wake-lock: native: the pairing's partial wake lock was held at Hold or released at Release (CD10, Task 38)
kinds.watch-failed: native: a device reading could not start or stop, with which (the sound check's recording, the microphone's session id (N8), or a watcher: camera, mic, device, the pose watch's start, stop and readings, the network's callbacks, or the previous exit's read, Task 37, review C7 I-4, M-8, M-9) and the throwable's class name
